description: WADL description with exactly one blocking defect: a resource applies resource_type #item, which the document does not declare.
document:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<application xmlns="http://wadl.dev.java.net/2009/02" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:tns="http://example.com/library">
  <doc>Library lending API</doc>
  <grammars>
    <xsd:schema targetNamespace="http://example.com/library">
      <xsd:element name="loan" type="tns:Loan"/>
      <xsd:complexType name="Loan"><xsd:sequence><xsd:element name="id" type="xsd:string"/></xsd:sequence></xsd:complexType>
    </xsd:schema>
  </grammars>
  <resources base="https://library.example.com/api/">
    <resource path="loans">
      <method name="GET" id="listLoans"><response status="200"><representation mediaType="application/xml" element="tns:loan"/></response></method>
      <resource path="{loanId}" type="#item"><param name="loanId" style="template" type="xsd:string"/></resource>
    </resource>
  </resources>
</application>
